source: 人教版2019选择性必修一 Unit 5 同主题完形(随爷爷学种地/一粒米的故事/我爱土壤/有机市场的小误会/提高收成/杂交水稻改变村庄)。用词限 U5/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位稍后打散。

passages.title: Learning to Work the Land
passages.text: Last summer I stayed with my grandfather and learned how to (1)____ the land. At first I thought farming was easy, but I was (2)____. He never used strong chemicals, because he said they could (4)____ the land and our health. Instead, he used animal waste as natural (5)____. He also told me to (6)____ the kind of crop in each field every year, so that the ground stayed rich in minerals. It was hard work, and my back often (7)____. But slowly I began to (8)____ how much care farming needs. By the end of the summer, I felt (9)____ of the vegetables we had grown together. passages.title: The Story of One Grain
passages.text: Have you ever thought about where the rice on your (1)____ comes from? Each grain begins as a tiny seed in the (2)____. Thanks to scientists like Yuan Longping, today's rice can give a much higher (9)____ than the rice of the past. passages.title: Why I Love the Soil
passages.text: My family is the one (1)____ has farmed this land for three generations. My grandfather often says that the soil is (2)____ to everything we eat. passages.title: A Mix-up at the Market
passages.text: Last week my friend Tom and I went to a (1)____ to buy some vegetables. Tom picked up some bright, shiny tomatoes, but I told him to (2)____. "These look beautiful," I said, "but they were grown with a lot of (3)____." Tom was surprised. He thought beautiful vegetables were always the (4)____ ones. Then I led him to a small corner that sold (7)____ vegetables, grown without any chemicals. "These are not as shiny," I said, "but they are (8)____ in minerals and much safer to eat." passages.title: Bringing in a Better Harvest
passages.text: When Mr Li took over the family farm, the (1)____ were small and the soil was poor. He knew he could not just hope for a better (2)____; he had to change the way he farmed. passages.title: How Hybrid Rice Changed a Village
